decision: D-12 (2026-07-30): formula route approved; ranges revised per user review (phi definition confirmed = porosity; Balbaa Eq-11 sign error corrected against the original)

model_source.citation: Sih & Barlow, Emissivity of Powder Beds, SFF 1995
model_source.verification: formulas transcribed from the original and re-derived from its Eqs 5-11 (3.082 = 4*0.514*3/2)

inputs.eps_solid_provenance: lower: Kieruj 2016 polished (Zhang 2019 adopted); upper: oxidized envelope (Sensors 2024, chamber ~0.5 % O2)
inputs.notation: phi_void = porosity (Sih-Barlow phi); the D-03 packing fraction is phi_pack = 1 - phi_void

observation: the interval is dominated by eps_solid; phi_void moves eps_powder by only 0.01-0.06 at fixed eps_solid
sensitivity_plan: two L1 thermal runs at the all-low and all-high extremes (D-12); freeze mid-values if interpass delta-T < 2 K, else propagate as uncertainty band
